lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Blueprints and hard hats fill the office. Frankie bursts in, furious[cite: 14].

lines.speaker: FRANKIE
lines.text: Vito's dead? And you're here counting bricks? Rizzo's moving on our docks[cite: 14]!

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: Vito was family. We don't hit blind[cite: 14].

lines.speaker: FRANKIE
lines.text: Vito was skimming! He gave everything to Rizzo. He got what he deserved[cite: 15].
